questions.question: Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting third to the right of D. Only one person is sitting between G and E when counted from the left of G. S is sitting to the immediate right of T. Only one person is sitting between G and T when counted from the right of G. Who is sitting third to the right of F?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) Only one person is sitting between G and E when counted from the left of G.

2) Only one person is sitting between G and T when counted from the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc595c066e0c4483329aad338635a5986db71ac77a4b5b5477265bd7c15cf434.png] 

3) S is sitting to the immediate right of T. 

4) R is sitting third to the right of D.

After positioning S, R and D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda016c2297ed6f3fda7a235b57e870ac4c35f15a1b8a618554d722c46b69367.png] 

Thus, T is sitting third to the right of F. 

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All shirts are pants.

All pants are watches.

Conclusions:

(I) All pants are shirts.

(II) All shirts are watches.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7542eb6f59cdb64f9fac15a8ac2f9ad28c6e4b8ed64bdb9f2eb0fd299c596490.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All pants are shirts → Does not follow (As all shirts are pants. So it is possible but not definite)

(II) All shirts are watches → Follow (As all shirts are pants and all pants are watches. As whole shirts comes in pants which whole comes in watches, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some plants are spices.

No spice is a lentil.

Conclusions:

(i) Some lentils are plants.

(ii) Some spices are plants.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336053d664f08bd2f9ca0d440d7ef9f19cac84a201004dd263de6a70f96c4d92.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some lentils are plants → Does not follow (As some plants are spices and no spice is a lentil. So it is possible but not definite)

(ii) Some spices are plants → Follow (As some plants are spices. As some part of plants is common with spices, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (ii) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying, etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

21 is related to 189 → __21 × 9__ = 189

And,

35 is related to 315 → __35 × 9__ = 315

Similarly,

43 is related to → __43 × 9__ = 387

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
